_comment: Printing's rights (docs/warehouse_picking_PRD.md §4.11, §4.15; Q-W14), shipped as a library layer.
Two slots the application must bind: printing:operators (the people at stations: read jobs, take and acknowledge
station jobs and PDF fallbacks through /spark/printing/station/*, which checks Read/PrintJob; reprint) and
printing:administrators (the agents' monitoring list as well).
Agents get no right here: an agent is a principal whose personal access token reaches only /spark/printing/agent/*,
and those endpoints serve only the printers configured for that agent (Spark:Printing:Agents, least privilege).
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "printing": false }.
